{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: release_snap

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      release:
        description: 'Release after build'
        required: true
        default: 'no'
  push:
    tags:
      - "v[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+"

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  BUILD_PYTHON_VERSION: "3.14"

jobs:
  build_snap:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: extractions/setup-just@v4

      - name: Set up Python ${{ env.BUILD_PYTHON_VERSION }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v7
        with:
          python-version: ${{ env.BUILD_PYTHON_VERSION }}

      - name: Install the latest version of uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@c771a70e6277c0a99b617c7a806ffedaca235ff9 # v9.0.0

      - name: Cache uv dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/uv
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-uv-${{ hashFiles('uv.lock', 'pyproject.toml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-uv-

      - name: Install requirements
        run: |
          sudo apt-get install -y desktop-file-utils appstream-util

      - name: Prepare
        run: |
          just build-linux-snap-no-build

      - uses: snapcore/action-build@v1
        id: build
        with:
          path: build/snap

      - name: Save snapped app
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: snap_result
          path: ${{ steps.build.outputs.snap }}

      - uses: snapcore/action-publish@v1
        if: github.event_name == 'push' || github.event.inputs.release == 'yes'
        env:
          SNAPCRAFT_STORE_CREDENTIALS: ${{ secrets.STORE_LOGIN }}
        with:
          snap: ${{ steps.build.outputs.snap }}
          release: edge
",
  "rationale": "The repository is a Python/uv project with uv.lock and pyproject.toml, and the workflow installs uv but currently has no dependency cache. Pattern P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (cache dependency downloads) reports a benefit and its preconditions are met: a lockfile exists for the cache key, dependency fetching repeats across runs, and no equivalent cache is already defined. Adding actions/cache for ~/.cache/uv keyed on uv.lock and pyproject.toml reuses dependency downloads without removing any step, weakening permissions, adding secrets, or introducing new network access; build and release coverage is preserved.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
